description: This file declares the WriteBuffer class, which is a task for writing audio buffer data in a WebAudio context within a media server. It includes class members for managing buffer pointers and lengths, and references to external interfaces and context.

classes.name: WriteBuffer
classes.description: A class representing a task to write audio buffer data for WebAudio playback, managing buffer pointers and lengths, and executing buffer write operations.

methods.name: WriteBuffer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the WriteBuffer task with context, buffer pointers, and lengths.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the buffer writing operation when invoked.
